dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $e, SUBQUERY($e.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.movie" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.audio" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.data" ).@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY($e.attachments, $p, ANY $p.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" ).@count == 0).@count >= 1
